original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target byte-for-byte with the read target-selection.json/full_target and mathematically with problem.md:1-41. It preserves the single complete selected target, arbitrary admissible M, all primes p and all characteristic-p fields K, 0≤λ<p, λ=0, p=2, and both nonzeroness and the full invariant-subspace conclusion. H001–H005 reproduce the original givens at problem.md:16-32; no proof conclusion became H and no original H was dropped. The irreducibility/highest-weight description within H003 is retained although the derivation only needs its dimension, representation and brackets together with H004. The final proof needs only x,y-invariance, retaining the original h-invariance condition. Parameters x,y,h are abstract Lie-algebra elements; H003 explains their operator notation, so D015 is the original Chevalley lattice rather than its possibly nonfaithful image (especially at λ=0). D001–D006 preserve n, integer indices, divided-power normalization and U_Z. D007–D009 keep M_R as the tensor module until R002/S001 proves iota injective. D010 has the actual N001 basis guard; D011 merely renames the supplied projector P as Pi. D012–D013 define coordinate membership without assuming rank one; D014–D017 give the original tensor reduction and prime-field maps. Their H guards and D dependencies are supplied at each using R, and no conclusion is concealed in their types. All calculations and phases of problem.md:45-182 are retained in R001–R006, splitting the original third phase into decomposition and rank/cyclicity; no material proof passage was omitted. Graph closure is the acyclic AND graph N001→N002→N003→N004→N005→P with explicit additional direct inputs, unique producers and both M roots used at R004/S002; every H is used. M001 and M002 were actually probed in the pinned Mathlib and compared with their complete signatures and source Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:297-302,345-378. The definition of strong rank condition was checked at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/InvariantBasisNumber.lean:118-123. Their statements preserve the semiring/module/free/finite/algebra conditions and the general natural-cardinal-rank meaning. There is no imported literature E. The Humphreys citation is frozen exercise provenance, not a theorem premise or a claim that its bibliography has independently been reverified; no missing literature text supports a proof step. Thus no deferred primary-source assumption is used. These are same-author mathematical inspections, separate from structural validation and independent Audit A.
